subject: Request: Private/VPC demo for HealthFirst - scheduling

From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@healthfirst.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Private/VPC demo for HealthFirst

Hi Marissa,

We signed up through the self-serve trial and I wanted to see if we could schedule a demo focused on Private/VPC deployment options for regulated workloads. HealthFirst is a mid-size digital health company and we need to evaluate private deployment (VPC or on-prem) for HIPAA workloads.

Key asks:
- High-level architecture for Private deployment (control plane vs data plane)
- KMS/HSM integration and audit logging
- Network requirements and expected latency/throughput per node
- SOC 2 artifacts and compliance discussion

Would love 30-45 minutes next week — available windows are Tue/Wed afternoons PT. I can loop in our security lead (Samir Khan) if helpful.

Thanks,
Jane
Director of Platform Ops
HealthFirst

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T10:02:00-07:00

Hi Jane — great to meet you and thanks for signing up. Happy to run a focused demo for Private/VPC and cover the items you listed. Looping in Monica (solutions engineer) to run the deep-dive and Ethan (SDR) to coordinate logistics.

Proposed times (PT):
- Tue Aug 25, 11:00–11:45am PT
- Wed Aug 26, 2:00–2:45pm PT
- Wed Aug 26, 4:00–4:45pm PT

If none of those work, share 2 slots that are best and we’ll do our best to accommodate. Also: can you confirm the attendee list and whether you want a security-only session or a fuller architecture + roadmap walkthrough?

Scheduling link: https://calendly.com/redwood/private-vpc-demo (or I can send a calendar invite once you confirm time).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
